description: Same-size male->male control for the cross-sex generalization check. test = the 9 SI-regime test-fold male speakers (genuinely held out from both this model and the pre-existing SI baseline -- no memorization-confound fix needed here, unlike the cross-sex female comparison). train size (38) matches cross_sex_male_train_female_test.json's male training set exactly, so training-set SIZE is held fixed relative to the cross-sex run and only the test set's SEX differs.
